value_kind_registry.semantic_version_string: STRING matching MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with no wildcard.
value_kind_registry.qualified_identifier: Lowercase dot-separated identifier resolved under namespace rules.
value_kind_registry.type_expression: One built-in or defined type, including declared type arguments.
value_kind_registry.value_expression: Expression producing a material value or a permitted special sentinel.
value_kind_registry.value_or_object_expression: Inline value expression or indented lowercase-key object value.
value_kind_registry.target_expression: REFERENCE, PATH, URI, GLOB, or material value accepted by the operation contract.
value_kind_registry.selector_expression: REFERENCE, PATH, URI, GLOB, or homogeneous LIST/SET of selectors.
value_kind_registry.boolean_expression: Expression statically producing BOOLEAN or UNKNOWN under special-value rules.
value_kind_registry.source_expression: PATH, URI, or REFERENCE to declared source data.
value_kind_registry.ordered_value: INTEGER, DECIMAL, STRING, DATE, TIME, DATETIME, DURATION, BYTES, PERCENTAGE, or same-unit MEASURE.
